options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: acl
options.description: Access controls on the bucket.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: cors
options.description: The bucket's Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration.

options.name: default_event_based_hold
options.description: Whether or not to automatically apply an eventBasedHold to new objects added to the bucket.

options.name: default_object_acl
options.description: Default access controls to apply to new objects when no ACL is provided.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: iam_configuration
options.description: IAM configuration for the storage bucket.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels applied to this bucket. A list of key->value pairs.

options.name: lifecycle
options.description: The bucket's lifecycle configuration. See U(https://developers.google.com/storage/docs/lifecycle) for more information.

options.name: location
options.description: The location of the bucket. Object data for objects in the bucket resides in physical storage within this region. Defaults to US. See the developer's guide for the authoritative list.

options.name: logging
options.description: The bucket's logging configuration, which defines the destination bucket and optional name prefix for the current bucket's logs.

options.name: metageneration
options.description: The metadata generation of this bucket.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the bucket.

options.name: owner
options.description: The owner of the bucket. This is always the project team's owner group.

options.name: predefined_default_object_acl
options.description: Apply a predefined set of default object access controls to this bucket. options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: storage_class
options.description: The bucket's default storage class, used whenever no storageClass is specified for a newly-created object. This defines how objects in the bucket are stored and determines the SLA and the cost of storage. Values include MULTI_REGIONAL, REGIONAL, STANDARD, NEARLINE, COLDLINE, ARCHIVE, and DURABLE_REDUCED_AVAILABILITY. options.name: versioning
options.description: The bucket's versioning configuration.

options.name: website
options.description: The bucket's website configuration, controlling how the service behaves when accessing bucket contents as a web site. See the Static Website Examples for more information.
